lines.en: 【K i l l h i m.】
【KimDokjaKimDokjaKimDokjaKimDokjaKimDokja!】
I walked toward the ‘Outer Gods’.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ did not stop me. As though daring me to try.
I took another step. The vines began moving even more violently. In an instant, they shot out and seized both my arms.
【Knowsusknowsusknowsusknowsus】
“That’s right. I know you.”
I nodded at them.
【Howhowhowhowhowhow】
How.

I cannot answer that question. When I gave no reply, the vines’ hostility toward me deepened. At last, a tentacle that had been hesitating shot forward and pierced my shoulder. It hurt terribly, but the real pain was not the pain in my shoulder.
Someone’s voice reached me through the tip of the tentacle.
「“I don’t want to die.”」
Was it an illusion?
For an instant, the tentacle piercing my shoulder looked like a sword.
……Twin Dragon Sword. I knew its owner.
「“I didn’t want it to end like this.”」
Lee Jihye was crying. I reached out too late; her face was already gone. Lee Jihye’s face, slowly fading. A voice fragmented and broken, with only scraps remaining.
‘Nameless Ones’.
“……I know.”
I said it through the pain. Then another tentacle flew at me. Behind me, Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999] shouted. With the sound of flesh being pierced, another voice reached me.
「“Yoo Joonghyuk-ssi, what number Lee Hyunsung am I to you?”」

The incarnation of steel, sturdier than anyone in the world. Once again, the moment I reached out, Lee Hyunsung’s form scattered like foam. A hand wandering through empty air. From beyond it, Lee Hyunsung’s voice reached me.
「“Is there really an end to this scenario?”」
“There is.”
I bite down hard on my lip and take a step.
One step. Then another.
With every step, fragments of forgotten worldlines spoke to me.
「“I thought I could do a little more.”」
Lee Seolhwa, dying with her heart pierced.
「“I don’t resent you. There’s just one thing I regret……”」
Shin Yoosung, scattering with a faint smile.
「“Idiot. Captain, I’m Kim Namwoon. Think I’m gonna bite it here? I’m not dying. I said I’m not dying. I’ll survive, and keep surviving, and see the next scenario. I swear, the next scenario—”」
There was Kim Namwoon, dead with his eyes open.
Memories from turns I could not even identify.
They were merely the by-products of failed worlds, a collection of memories that had lost their meaning.
Something precious that Yoo Joonghyuk had protected even as he became the ‘Secretive Plotter’.
「“I’m not taking your side next turn. Don’t come looking for me.”」
Gong Pildu.
「“You’ll be left alone again, Yoo Joonghyuk.”」
Anna Croft.
「“It was an honor to fight alongside you, Supreme King.”」
Selena Kim.
Memories of beings who had once been constellations flashed past as well.
Goryeo’s First Sword, Cheok Jungyeong.
The God of Wine and Ecstasy, Dionysus……
I stopped walking because of the searing flames I felt to my right.
The tentacle holding my arm was burning as it spoke to me.
「“I can still burn more.”」
……Uriel.
I nodded and said,
“I know.”
[The ‘Outer Gods’ are looking at you.]
I know. But I do not understand.
Because I am not you.
And so, this is all I can say to you.
“This story isn’t over yet.”
[The ‘Outer Gods’ are listening to your words.]
“There are still things left to tell.”
I looked up at the ‘Outer Gods’.
Beings described only as cephalopods and tentacled monsters. Because this worldline had no need for them, they had been given the forms it found most repulsive.
I spoke to them.
“I’ll tell your stories.”
At that moment, a gale swept through our surroundings.
【Reallyreallyreallyreallyreally】
【Whatdoesthatmeanwhatdoesthatmeanwhatdoesthatmean】
And from another direction, savage hostility poured down on me.
【L i a r!】
【D o y o u t h i n k w e w i l l b e f o o l e d t w i c e?】
The higher gods unleashed their force toward me.
I swallowed the blood surging into my throat and looked at them. I knew why they were reacting so violently. They had been exploited in the ‘scenarios’ all along.
【T h e d o k k a e b i s s a i d t h a t t o o】

The ‘Bureau’ had discovered their existence long ago and used them. The storytellers who exploited their strength and probability under the pretext of including them in the scenarios, and made them this world’s ‘Evil.’
I released my True Voice.
[I’m not a dokkaebi.]
【Y o u a r e a c o n s t e l l a t i o n.】
[I don’t belong to the Bureau, and I don’t serve the dokkaebis.]
【A l l c o n s t e l l a t i o n s a r e t h e s a m e.】
The words dug into my chest like a dagger.
They were right. I, too, was just a constellation who coveted Stories and watched stories like a voyeur.
But there were things I could know precisely because I was such a constellation.
[When the ‘Final War’ breaks out, you will be destroyed. However you fight, you will lose in the end.]
【Y o u a r r o g a n t w r e t c h, u n l e s s w e t r y……!】
[I know without trying. Because I’ve seen every worldline in which you fought. And I don’t want you to die that way again.]
The branches of the ‘Outer Gods’ swayed at my words.
【W h a t d o e s t h a t m e a n.】
[You said you wanted to be understood. I’ll make you into a Story.]
At that moment, space and time warped around us. The faint trembling of tentacles.
Feeling that trembling, I continued.
[I’ll put you on an equal footing with the stars in that sky. I’ll create a Story in which nobody misunderstands or despises you.]
The agitation slowly spread. Like the herald of a storm, a tremendous current swept through ‘N'Gai's Forest’. I seized the opening and kept speaking.
[The ‘Final War’ doesn’t have to happen. You don’t have to be the <Star Stream>’s Evil any—]
【S h u t y o u r m o u t h】
【H o w d a r e t h e l i k e s o f y o u!】
At last, I coughed up blood. Higher Outer Gods were descending, ready to shatter my body and erode my mind.
【KimDokjaindangerKimDokjaindanger】
【Don’tattackdon’tattackdon’tattack】
Vines wrapping around me.
Facing the overwhelming power of the higher gods, the ‘Nameless Ones’ were protecting me.
【W o r t h l e s s t h i n g s w i t h o u t e v e n a s e l f.】
Rrrrrumble!
A single utterance in True Voice tore apart dozens of branches. Yet even as they screamed in pain, the small ‘Outer Gods’ protected me.
And the Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuks stood in front of me.
The ‘Secretive Plotter’ neither stopped nor restrained them. He simply watched. As though this were a choice he could not make for them.
At last, when the higher gods’ Status reached its critical point.
[You say interesting things.]
Someone’s voice rang out. Someone walking through an ominously swirling portal was speaking.
[You pitiful bastards of the worldlines. He is right.]
【You, are?】
[You can become Stories again, told amid the flow of the stars. Provided that unfortunate constellation can give himself up for your sake.]
The old man was very small, but his shadow was enormous.
Two lumps swayed on the enormous shadow’s cheeks.
【D e m o n o f t h e H o r i z o n……】
I knew that species as well.
When I first went to the Demon Realm, I made a deal with one of them.
But the being before me now was on an entirely different level from the ‘Wenny man’ I had met then.
There were many Wenny men in the world, but only one old man with ‘two’ lumps.
[Owner of the old library.]
I raised my head. The Wenny King peered at me with wicked curiosity in his eyes.
[Do you truly intend to become the <Star Stream>’s enemy for the sake of this refuse?]
In the distance, I saw the forest’s round exit opening.
Behind me, countless Outer Gods crowded together to see me off. Tentacles swaying like a vast reed bed.
【KimDokjaKimDokjaKimDokjaKimDokja】
【Goodbyegoodbyegoodbyegoodbyegoodbye】
Most of them looked the same, but now I could vaguely tell them apart.

The one on the left was a good fellow with a fingernail’s worth of memories from the twelfth turn’s Shin Yoosung, while the one on the right contained quite a lot of the forty-fourth turn’s Kim Namwoon…… I think that bastard stabbed my thigh earlier.
“You didn’t need to go this far.”
Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999], perched on my shoulder, spoke.
“A contract with the Wenny King is absolute. If you do this, you will certainly—”
“I’m not going to die, so don’t worry. Are you coming too?”
Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999] looked displeased.
“I’m your monitor, as promised. It would be troublesome if you contacted the other members of <Kim Dokja’s Company> and plotted something.”
“I even made an Existence Oath not to contact them…… Honestly, you Yoo Joonghyuks.”
Until I fulfilled the contract, I was neither to contact <Kim Dokja’s Company> nor reveal my existence to them. That was my first promise to the Wenny King and the Outer Gods.
And the second promise was……
[Your actions have triggered a new scenario branch in the <Star Stream>!]
[A hidden scenario has occurred!]
Reading the scenario, I laughed hollowly.
Even something like this became a scenario…… Typical <Star Stream>.
Well, this was a world that could turn even its own destruction into a story.
<Hidden Scenario — Proof of Promise>
Category: Hidden
Difficulty: ???
Clear Conditions: Make the ‘Outer Gods’ appear in the <Star Stream>’s major Giant Stories. However, they must not appear in their customary roles as ‘Outer Gods’.
Time Limit: 100 days
Reward: The trust of the ‘Outer Gods’, ???
Failure: You will lose all your memories and transform into an ‘Outer God’.
Give the ‘Outer Gods’ roles other than ‘Outer Gods’……
It was a scenario that had never existed anywhere in the original.
A scenario I had obtained by persuading the ‘Outer Gods’ and making a contract with the ‘Wenny King’.
If I failed it, I would become an ‘Outer God’ just like them. That was the condition of my contract with the ‘Wenny King’.
「But if I succeeded, the ‘Outer Gods’ would not be destroyed.」
Looking at the exit of ‘N'Gai's Forest’, I stretched lightly.
[999] asked, apparently unconvinced.
“Where do you intend to go? There should be very few ‘Giant Story’ scenarios left.”
He was right.
Most of the <Star Stream>’s Giant Stories had now reached their final acts.
But if my memory was correct, one powerful ‘Giant Story’ still remained.
I casually asked [999],
“Do you know the story of the 1863rd turn too?”
“I heard it from the Great Plotter.”
“If you enter the ‘Final War’ like this, you’re certain to lose. Even if you miraculously win, hardly anyone will survive.”
“Are you cursing us?”
“No, I’m telling you the truth.”

However powerful the ‘Secretive Plotter’ and the ‘Outer Gods’ were, they could not fight the whole <Star Stream>. After all, the rulers of this universe were still the <Star Stream>’s nebulas and the damned ‘Bureau’.
“The best way to avoid a war is to let the other side know they’d only stand to lose by fighting one.”
“What are you trying to say?”
“Do you know which constellation slaughtered the most ‘Outer Gods’ in the ‘Final War’?”
[999] thought carefully before answering. His expression suggested that his pride was slightly hurt.
“I don’t.”
“His Status is so tremendous that he normally exists split into several beings. Well, in a way, he’s similar to the ‘Secretive Plotter’.”
“……Similar to the Great Plotter?”
“Yes. If he hadn’t sided with the <Star Stream>, and hadn’t taken tens of thousands of Outer Gods down with him…… the 1863rd turn would have gone very differently.”
For the first time, Yoo Joonghyuk [999]’s gaze wavered at my words.
He seemed to have realized which constellation I meant.
“……You don’t mean?”
The constellation who had perished together with countless Outer Gods in the Final War of ‘Ways of Survival’.
There had only ever been one such being. I grinned and said,
“That’s right. We’re going to get him on our side.”
A pure-white figure rose in the pitch-black darkness.
Yoo Joonghyuk swung his sword at him again and again. From Breaking the Sky Sword Thunder to Meteor Slash. Yet not a single strike could even brush his enemy’s shadow.
The clash of Stories followed. With a startled groan, Yoo Joonghyuk opened his eyes.
Inside the training room after sunset. A long shadow looked down at him.
It was the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint.
“Was he strong?”
His master crouched with her back bent, her eyes full of concern for her disciple. Yoo Joonghyuk bit his lip and answered.
“……He was.”
“How strong?”
“I couldn’t beat him even after opening stage five of Transcendent Form.”
Stage five of Transcendent Form was the limit Yoo Joonghyuk had currently reached.
The Breaking the Sky Sword Saint gazed down at him quietly, then spoke.
“Once you surpass stage six of Transcendent Form, your [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] will no longer be restricted by gender.”
[Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] was originally a martial art for women. But as with every martial art, beyond a certain level lay transcendence of boundaries (脫境界).
Constantly escaping those countless boundaries was precisely how transcendents trained.
“There’s no guarantee I could beat him even if I reached stage six.”
“Why do you think that?”
“He is me.”
For the first time, a faint fear colored Yoo Joonghyuk’s normally unyielding voice.
“He is me after regressing 1,863 times. How am I supposed to beat someone like that?”
Utter despair.

The moment he faced the ‘Secretive Plotter’, Yoo Joonghyuk had seen a towering wall he could never overcome, whatever he did. An expanse of time he could not begin to fathom with a mere three turns of regression. His enemy had crossed that time to reach this worldline. The Breaking the Sky Sword Saint said,
“He is not you.”
“……He is also Yoo Joonghyuk.”
“You haven’t walked the same path as him. And you won’t walk it in the future, either.”
As though wiping the despair from her disciple’s eyes, the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint’s large hand covered his cheek. She continued.
“Which stage of Transcendent Form you’ve reached matters less than which Stories you’ve built. You may be a novice who has regressed only three times, but don’t you know Stories he doesn’t?”
Hearing her words, Yoo Joonghyuk looked down at his fist. The fist that had failed to reach the ‘Secretive Plotter’. As he slowly opened it, Stories flowed out.
The Stories he had built. Stories the ‘Secretive Plotter’ did not know. And.
“Every path to transcendence is different. Don’t try to catch up to him. Find the path only you can walk.”
Without a word, Yoo Joonghyuk clenched his fist.
As though refusing to let a single one of those Stories escape.
“……Is there any news?”
The Breaking the Sky Sword Saint shook her head.
It had already been a week since Kim Dokja disappeared.
But neither his whereabouts nor the location of the ‘Secretive Plotter’ had been determined.
“You said he was you from another worldline.”
“Yes.”
“I don’t know what he wants, but if he came to this worldline at this particular moment, it may have something to do with the ‘Final Scenario’.”
Yoo Joonghyuk agreed with her.
In other words, going to the Final Scenario’s region would give them a good chance of finding the ‘Secretive Plotter’.
“However, <Kim Dokja’s Company> cannot enter the ‘Final Scenario’ at present.”
Yoo Joonghyuk nodded.
—You have not accumulated enough Stories to be permitted into the ‘Final Scenario’.

The day they failed to enter the Final Scenario. That was the unilateral notice the <Bureau> had delivered. He had thought it plausible. After all, they were only a new nebula, with few Stories to their name.
But considering the grades of the Stories they had built, it could not be put quite so simply.
In particular, the Giant Story they had acquired last, 「Season of Light and Darkness」, was something rarely found anywhere in the <Star Stream>.
—Where is your nebula’s representative?
Ultimately, it all came down to Kim Dokja’s absence.
With Kim Dokja, the holder of the largest share of their Stories, separated from the party, the nebula’s total quantity of Stories had fallen short.
Yoo Joonghyuk fell silent for a moment, lost in his own thoughts. How much time passed? Slowly rising, he sheathed the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword], then staggered to his feet.
“Where are you going?”
“To obtain a new Giant Story.”

They had to qualify for the Final Scenario even without Kim Dokja’s share. The members of <Kim Dokja’s Company> were neither his private army nor his subordinates. They had to be able to protect themselves without him. And even if they lost Kim Dokja……
They had to be able to clear the Final Scenario.
[Baat……]
In midair, Biyoo made a mournful sound. Yoo Joonghyuk looked up at her briefly, then activated [Sage’s Eye] to review the information he knew.
At this point, there were almost no regions left where a ‘Giant Story’ could be acquired easily.
Conversely, that meant the remaining ‘Giant Stories’ were all the more powerful.
The powerful Giant Story 「Season of Light and Darkness」 already in their possession.
If they could obtain ‘that Story’ as well, a fight with the ‘Secretive Plotter’ might not be out of the question.
The Breaking the Sky Sword Saint called after Yoo Joonghyuk as he walked away.
“Will you go alone?”
“I’ve always been alone.”
“Your other self has already walked that path.”
Her disciple stopped short.
Then, a voice came from outside the training ground.
“Hey, where’s Yoo Joonghyuk? We need to leave!”
Amid dazzling light, the members of <Kim Dokja’s Company> pushed open the training room door and burst inside.
Shin Yoosung, Lee Gilyoung, Lee Jihye, Han Sooyoung……
How long had they been preparing? Everyone from <Kim Dokja’s Company> had gathered there. The Breaking the Sky Sword Saint spoke.
“They are your Stories, Joonghyuk.”
What the ‘Secretive Plotter’ did not have.
As Yoo Joonghyuk turned back in a daze, the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint said,
“In this turn, you don’t have to fight alone.”
The new ‘Giant Story’ region was four days away. With help from the dokkaebis, we could have arrived much sooner, but this time that was not allowed.
—You cannot borrow the power of dokkaebis with whom you are acquainted.
—You must never let anyone know that you are ‘Kim Dokja’.
It was because of my contract with the damned ‘Wenny King’.
Because of that contract, I could neither enter Biyoo’s channel nor let <Kim Dokja’s Company> know I was safe.
In the end, I had no choice but to drive the [X-grade Ferrarghini] I had bought from the ‘Mass Production Maker’ to our destination myself.
On my shoulder, Yoo Joonghyuk [999] was polishing the [Splitting the Sky Sword] when he muttered,
“You’re a poor driver.”
“Then you drive. Are you seriously going to stay like that?”
Once we entered the scenario region, we were bound to meet constellations who recognized us. In that situation, Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk would stand out far too much.
Yoo Joonghyuk himself was already so famous……
“True. I would be too conspicuous like this.”
After considering something, Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999] twitched. A moment later, with a pop, he turned into a small murim dumpling.
I was startled. [999] spoke to me in an indifferent voice.
—This should do.
“……Walking around with a dumpling on my shoulder will stand out even more.”
—Change that pathetic appearance of yours too.
Just as Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk could not remain in Yoo Joonghyuk’s form, I could not let anyone discover that I was ‘Kim Dokja’.
Having become a murim dumpling, Yoo Joonghyuk began roughly rubbing dumpling skin over my face as though applying makeup. I felt the Story of my face creak and shift. How much time passed?
When I opened my eyes, I was truly stunned.
As I blinked at myself in the mirror, Yoo Joonghyuk [999] said to me,
—Done.
Good grief. Maybe these looks weren’t quite enough to put Yoo Joonghyuk to shame…… but they were enough to make me consider trying.
Rubbing my sculpted face, I muttered,
“……Can’t you make this permanent?”
—Do that and you’ll suffer a probability backlash.
As though he had touched something filthy, [999] busily dusted off his dumpling body.
I paid him no mind and kept studying myself in the mirror.
I had become handsome when I absorbed a Story fragment from ‘Casanova Who Died of Sexual Exhaustion’, but that was nothing compared to this.
In an admiring voice, I continued.
“The 999th turn really is something. The third-turn version can’t do this.”
—……Third turn?
“Oh, you didn’t know? The Yoo Joonghyuk here is on his third turn. This is the third-turn worldline.”
Kkoma Yoo Joonghyuk [999] studied me for a moment before asking,
—Why do you think that?
“Why? Well……”
I was about to say, “Because ‘Ways of Survival’ starts in the third turn,” but stopped myself.
I decided to soften the wording a little.
“……Because it starts in the third turn.”
—Why is the third turn the beginning? Can’t you count? The beginning is the zeroth turn.
He was right.
The first episode of ‘Ways of Survival’ began with Yoo Joonghyuk’s third turn, but strictly speaking, the whole story began with his zeroth turn.
Thinking of it that way made me feel a little strange.
……Why had I come to Yoo Joonghyuk’s ‘third turn’?
Things weren’t following the third turn’s story exactly anyway. Just because the novel opened in the third turn, there should have been no need for me to begin there.
……I didn’t know. It wasn’t something I could work out right now anyway.
“This worldline’s Yoo Joonghyuk said he was on his ‘third turn’. So this is the third turn.”
And that was exactly what I had seen in [Character List] as well.
Then [999] said,
—You’re naive, believing information like that at face value.
“What?”
—Never mind. We seem to have arrived.
With a dazzling light, the long dimensional tunnel ended.
What appeared next was an enormous gate leading to a new scenario region.
A crowd was waiting at its entrance. I put away the [X-grade Ferrarghini] and joined the line.
The entrance to the scenario region was guarded by a constellation, not a dokkaebi. Understandably so, since this ‘Giant Story’ scenario was also hosted by a nebula.
One of the supermassive nebulas, though until now our paths had hardly crossed.
[Next.]
A constellation wearing a red crown and ancient armor, with a huge trident in one hand.
The domineering Status emanating from his whole body revealed him to be a Narrative-grade constellation of no ordinary standing.
Guardian of Buddha’s Law (佛法), Virudhaka (增長天王).
He was one of the Four Heavenly Kings (四天王) guarding the entrance to the <Heavenly Palace>, the <Emperor> nebula’s headquarters.
[Next.]
Before long, it was my turn.
Virudhaka scrutinized my face, as if searching for anything suspicious, then asked his first question.
[Purpose of visit?]
[I’ve come to participate in the Giant Story.]
[Modifier.]
I could not say ‘Demon King of Salvation’ here.
Fortunately, I had acquired a new modifier this time.
[‘Watcher of Light and Darkness’.]
A few constellations in the line behind me began murmuring.
I wondered if my modifier had already become widely known, but fortunately that did not seem to be it.
[He must have had it changed at the Bureau’s naming office, right? Are they still doing that?]
[I thought nothing could surpass ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ for that sort of modifier……]
[Tsk. Why do all the young ones these days have modifiers like that?]
……I had a pretty good idea what they were getting at.
After a simple inspection, Virudhaka looked down at my shoulder.
[What is that dumpling?]
[My lunch.]
[……Unusual. Someone with cotton candy came through yesterday.]
Cotton candy?
[Next.]
Fortunately, Virudhaka let me through without incident.
[You have entered the channel overseeing the scenario region.]
As I entered the gate, a brilliant rainbow aurora swept over me, followed by a guide message and video.
[Welcome to the <Emperor> nebula’s world!]
……Even the entrance video was on a different level.
When I blinked, I was standing on a white cloud.
The cloud flew swiftly with me aboard. Looking to the side, I saw a handsome golden monkey flying through the air beside me.
「“Let’s go, friend.”」
The monkey winked at me, somersaulted in midair, and swung an enormous Ruyi Jingu Bang. The scene in the sky changed, and countless demons began swarming toward us.
Even knowing it was a fake video, I could not help being overwhelmed.
[The most beautiful epic in the world.]
Because this was the most famous Giant Story the <Emperor> nebula possessed.
The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal, Sun Wukong, fighting countless demons.
And I saw the heavenly troops following behind him.
[We invite you into that magnificent world of adventure.]
When the video ended, I found myself standing on the plaza floor.
The dumpling on my shoulder spoke.
—A gaudy sales pitch.
“Don’t talk. You’re a dumpling.”
Embarrassed that I had gotten a little excited, I grumbled for no good reason.
Slowly looking around, I took in the full view of the <Heavenly Palace>.

A plaza filled with elegant old palaces. The traces of a civilization glittering in brilliant gold. Before my eyes unfolded a world built by stars coming together and building up one another’s Stories.
I had visited other nebulas’ bases, but I had never seen a world with a crowd this enormous.
For now, I decided to explore a little more.
Then I saw a holographic video running across the plaza’s display board.
—All members of the nebula <Kim Dokja’s Company> missing!
—Reported to have entered a new Giant Story scenario……
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ is activating strongly!]
—Where will <Kim Dokja’s Company> go next?
Yoo Joonghyuk and his companions were there, passing through a dazzling gate.
I stopped for a while and watched them pass beyond the brilliant light.
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ activates even more strongly!]
……A new ‘Giant Story’.
I could roughly guess what was happening.

The companions would be running around trying to acquire a new Giant Story by now. Since I had separated from <Kim Dokja’s Company>, they would lack the Story shares needed to enter the ‘Final Scenario’.
When I turned my head, Yoo Joonghyuk [999] was looking at me.
—I trust you won’t act rashly.
“……I know. Don’t worry.”
I wanted nothing more than to return to the companions immediately, but at present I could not contact any of them.
—This is for your companions’ sake, not yours.
“I know.”
Even without the contract, for the time being I would be walking a thorny path on which no one’s life was assured. One rash attempt at contact could put the entire party in danger.
[Would you like to move to the Giant Story scenario area?]
I nodded.
[Automatic guidance to the scenario area will begin.]
As expected of a nebula pursuing the ultimate in convenience, my legs began running automatically.
Beside me, several incarnations were running automatically in the same pose.
We awkwardly avoided each other’s eyes.
[Automatic guidance has ended.]
I arrived in front of an enormous holographic panel installed on the west side of the plaza.
Many constellations and incarnations had already gathered before it. Golden statues rose above the crowd.
The statue at the center depicted a constellation I knew well.
The golden-haired Prisoner of the Golden Headband, holding the enormous Ruyi Jingu Bang (如意金箍棒).
Statues of the protagonists of Journey to the West (西遊記), foremost among them the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal, Sun Wukong.
As expected, <Emperor> seemed well aware of which story in its world was the most famous.
[A new main scenario has arrived!]
And this scenario was connected to precisely that ‘famous story’.
I opened the scenario window.
<Main Scenario #94 — Journey to the West Remake>
Category: Main
Difficulty: ???

Clear Conditions: Create a ‘Story chamber’ together with other constellations or incarnations and remake Journey to the West. The remade Journey to the West will be evaluated in real time by judges and audiences, with an overall score based on criteria including ‘popularity,’ ‘fidelity to the original,’ and ‘originality.’ The Story with the most votes at the end will win the scenario.
Time Limit: —
Reward: A Giant Story related to ‘Journey to the West’, the <Emperor> nebula’s goodwill, 3,000,000 coins, ???
Failure: —
●The copyright to the reconstructed Stories will be jointly owned by the <Emperor> nebula and the participants.
●Depending on the judges’ votes, you may obtain a ‘Legendary-grade’ or ‘Historical-grade’ Story.
●Each participant may play only one role (excluding extras).
●Additional coins will be awarded according to rank.
<Emperor> really did operate on another scale.
Making the adaptation of its own Giant Story into a scenario……

Judging by the children’s participation in this chamber, most of the others were probably also from <Kim Dokja’s Company>. But if someone with ill intentions toward them had slipped in……
“……I told you to just let us carry you.”
A small but powerful hand gripped my shoulder.
Turning, I saw a chilling smile on Shin Yoosung’s face.
“You’re not even dressed properly. Stay back!”
Cracking his knuckles, Lee Gilyoung also stepped forward.
I tried to hurry after them, but the children had already raced toward the gorge and begun a fierce battle with a blue dragon that had flown up.
“Ka-booooooooom!”
As Lee Gilyoung charged, shouting a sound effect, the blue dragon that had sprung from the gorge roared back. I immediately realized who it was.
……Chimera Dragon?
The children fought the blue dragon in midair as though dancing, then used [Taming] to subdue it in an instant.
[The audience admires the little Sanzangs’ martial prowess!]
[A few audience members protest that Sanzang is too strong.]
[Some judges are surprised by the unexpected development!]
A moment later.
[Player6 has joined the party!]
Having become Xuanzang’s white horse, Chimera Dragon whined as the children dragged it over.
Seeing that the incident had been resolved without my lifting a finger, I recalled my exchange with the Scenario Master.
—What does a retired Sun Wukong do?
—Nothing.
At last, I thought I was beginning to understand.
This story had been designed that way from the start.
Then a familiar constellation’s message rang out.
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ is interested in the Story’s development.]
[10 bonus points have been added.]
As one day passed, then two, I gradually came to understand this Story chamber’s true nature.
“It’s a grasshopper. Eat it.”
“Demon King of Salvation-nim, do your legs hurt?”
「This Story is a ‘Story for Sun Wukong’.」
(Sun Wukong was comfortable.)
Since the scenarios began, I had never been this idle.
It felt as though my brain was going numb, steeped in comfort.
[A new Story is germinating within you!]
[The Story ‘Blowing One’s Nose Without Lifting a Finger’ begins its story.]
I could roughly guess why Han Sooyoung had written this scenario.
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ likes this development.]
Journey to the West was a story built on Sun Wukong’s sacrifices. Even most of its later variations followed a similar structure.
But what if a Story that comforted Sun Wukong appeared?
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ envies you.]
[Judge ‘Manager of Heaven’s Stables’ envies you.]
[Votes: 312]
It seemed Han Sooyoung really was a popular author.
The Story’s votes had already passed three hundred, and it continued sailing smoothly.
This development was not bad for the companions either.

Sun Wukong might be the nominal protagonist, but since the other companions handled all the actual fighting, the final Story shares would naturally belong to <Kim Dokja’s Company>. Gaining votes and collecting Story shares: it was a meticulously crafted design.
“Ah, I want to play a phone game.”
“You played plenty before we came in.”
Even as they bickered, the children fed me, put me to bed, and even groomed my hair. Lee Gilyoung asked bluntly,
“What do you normally do, anyway?”
“It’s rude to ask about someone’s private life, idiot.”
Beside me, Shin Yoosung, who was likewise plucking my gray hairs, objected.
I worried a little whether this sort of meta conversation was allowed, but decided to answer. Come to think of it, I had never had a conversation like this with the children.
“I just like reading novels.”
“Novels? Oh, I like them too.”
Lee Gilyoung liked reading novels? That was unexpected information.
Excited, he continued.
“Want me to recommend one?”
Daring to recommend a novel to me, when I’d been reading genre fiction for over ten years? Let’s hear it.
“[SSSSS-grade Infinite Regressor]. It’s fun as hell, so make sure you read it.”
My second self slipped out before I knew it.
“That is one of the greatest disasters ever written.”
“A disaster? I heard it was really popular. You have no taste~”
That bastard Han Sooyoung. Had she been bragging to the children about her own novel?
Shin Yoosung, who had been listening beside us, joined in.
“I like novels too!”
“Do you? What kinds of novels do you like?”
My hopes rose a little. Yes, if it was Yoosung—
“Yes! R-Raymond Carver, Haruki Murakami……!”
……A very familiar lineup of authors.
I thought I knew who had been teaching the children while I was gone.
Yoo Sangah-ssi would have reincarnated safely by now, wouldn’t she?
Looking at the dumpling on my shoulder, Shin Yoosung asked,
“You must like murim dumplings, then?”
“Yes, I do.”
“……A man I know loves them too.”
I knew very well who liked them.
Rubbing his stomach, Lee Gilyoung muttered as well.
“Ah, I want dumplings.”
I felt the murim dumpling on my shoulder twitch.
Come to think of it, it had been far too long since I had a proper meal.
(Then, suddenly, the smell of dumplings began drifting from somewhere.)
Most incidents in Journey to the West began ‘suddenly,’ just like this.
Exchanging glances, we followed that fantastic smell toward its source.
How long did we walk along the little path?
An enormous factory complex appeared before us.
“……How could anything like this exist in this era?”
Just as I wondered whether Han Sooyoung’s Journey to the West was set in a steampunk world, several people ran toward us from inside the complex.
“Ugh, everyone run!”
But everyone trying to escape was caught, as though drawn by an invisible force, and pulled back into the factory.
“Nooooooo!”
Wondering what on earth was happening, we sneaked closer to the factory.
Before long, we saw thousands of slaves stationed at conveyor belts, kneading and shaping something.
“Don’t tell me those are……”
The dumpling [999] on my shoulder spoke.
—[Murim dumplings].
Thousands of murim dumplings were being carried somewhere along a container belt.
Watching the endless river of dumplings, I thought of the character we would meet this time.
(There is only one character in Journey to the West who covets food like this.)
And, as though he had been waiting, a man spoke to us.
